newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-SILVA TAKES OVER AS COACH AT DEPORTIVO CORUNA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SILVA TAKES OVER AS COACH AT DEPORTIVO CORUNA.

text.p: Carlos Alberto Silva agreed on Wednesday to take over from Briton John Toshack as coach at Deportivo Coruna until the end of the season.

"(I like) the most direct route to goal," said the former Olympic coach, promising a return to attacking football. Silva, who has managed some of Brazil's most prestigious sides, has already worked as a scout for Deportivo.
He will find a number of Brazilians at the club, including defender Mauro Silva, midfielders Rivaldo, Donato and Flavio Conceicao and striker Renaldo.

Choosing who to drop among the wealth of talent at Deportivo was one of the problems faced by Toshack, who resigned on Sunday after a run of bad results aggravated his already difficult relationship with club officials, fans and players.
Luis Aragones remains the most likely candidate to occupy the bench at the Riazor stadium next season. League rules forbid him to take over now as he has already managed Valenica this season.
